scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply bookmark --local
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:web && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev
scripts.build:web: npm run build:extension && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.deploy: npm run setup:check && npm run build:web && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply bookmark --remote && npx wrangler deploy
